overview.heading: Engineering Partners for India's Industrial Backbone
paragraphs: Keshav Enterprises is a precision industrial engineering company headquartered in Shamli, Uttar Pradesh. Founder Shekhar Sharma has worked hands-on with steam turbines since 1988; that experience became an independent partnership in 2016, and Keshav Enterprises was formally established in June 2020. We provide specialist turbine maintenance, reverse engineering, and OEM-compatible spare parts to clients across India and worldwide, including exports to Nepal and Uganda.

Our engineering team includes ex-OEM specialists from Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss & Morcom, Man Turbo, KKK, and ABB, giving clients the same level of technical expertise as the original equipment manufacturers, at a fraction of the lead time and cost.

We cover steam turbines from 5 kW to 60 MW: back-pressure and condensing, horizontal and vertical, single and multi-stage. Our workshop is equipped with 3D laser scanners, CMM coordinate measuring machines, dynamic balancing machines (50–2,000 kg), and precision CNC lathes.

paragraphs: Keshav Enterprises holds an active Importer-Exporter Code (IEC) issued by the DGFT, the legal credential required to ship turbine engineering spares, industrial filtration products, and OEM-compatible components outside India. We have already exported basket strainers to Nepal and lube oil filters and shear pins to Uganda.

Our precision-manufactured products are produced to international standards including ISO 16889, API 614, and ASME Sec. VIII, and classified under standard HSN export codes, so overseas buyers can verify compliance before placing an order.
